text: Amavasya is the moonless night, a time we set aside for those who came before us.
This is not out of fear, but from the understanding that a family which remembers its elders knows its roots and where it stands.
On this day, you might offer water to Surya Bhagavan in the morning.
In the evening, light a deepam at home.
A beautiful way to connect with your heritage is to tell someone younger in the house one story about a grandparent they never met.
